propositions: The Git version floor gate step reads .github/git-version-floor.txt from the checked-out patchset tree but hard-fails when absent, even though Gerrit's Verified lane sources the workflow definition from main

Every change branched before the gate and its data file merged receives the gate step without .github/git-version-floor.txt and fails with ::error::missing, regardless of what the change actually touches

The gate violates the documented 'Definition-vs-tree skew guard (ticket ee2a)' convention already implemented in adjacent steps (raw-git-write gate, wall-clock-assert gate): new gate steps must skip with a log line when their data file is absent from the checked-out tree, not hard-fail

The fix applies the established if-present guard pattern: absent floor file skips with an explanatory log line naming the real remedy (change predates the gate; re-enforces on rebase), while an actual under-floor git still fails with required version, installed version and upgrade path preserved unchanged
